maria (Docs): Heads-up — PR #6123 needs a final pass. Streaming + pagination snippets across Python/TS/Go are missing resume-token TTL and jittered retry examples. Can someone pick this up?

sam (SDK): I can take it. Which files are we touching?

maria (Docs): docs/snippets/sdk/streaming-resume/* and the example app at examples/get-started/stream-paginate/README.md. Also small callout in docs/guides/pagination.md.

jon (Go eng): For Go I can add a concise context-cancel + exponential-backoff snippet. Draft: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
resp, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
for msg := range resp.Chunks() {
  fmt.Println(msg.Text)
}
// retry helper: backoff := backoff.Exponential{Base:100*time.Millisecond, Max:2*time.Second}
```

eli (PY SDK): I pushed a python draft to branch maria/stream-snips. Key bit: show retry with jitter + resume token validation. Excerpt: ```py
from sdk import Retry, ExpJitter
resp = client.stream(request, retry=Retry(backoff=ExpJitter(base=0.1, max=2.0)))
for chunk in resp:
    if chunk.resume_token and validate(chunk.resume_token):
        resume_token = chunk.resume_token
    print(chunk.text)
```

linda (TS SDK): TS needs an async-iterator pattern example and a tiny note about typing for resume tokens. I'll add: ```ts
for await (const part of client.stream(req)) {
  if (part.resumeToken) resume = part.resumeToken
  console.log(part.text)
}
```

maria (Docs): Two small content asks: 1) explicitly state resume tokens expire after 24h (we can link to the token TTL policy) 2) show a one-paragraph fallback to polling when resume fails (example pseudocode fine). Keep snippets minimal — no full app.

sam (SDK): Should we surface batching knobs (batch_size) here or is that extra?

maria (Docs): Keep it terse. Add one inline note: "set batch_size for throughput vs latency trade-offs". No deep dive.

deploy-bot: docs preview built for PR 6123 — https://deploy.preview/docs/pr-6123 (build passed) :white_check_mark:

eli (PY SDK): @sam @jon can you double-check the API shapes in my python snippet? I used `resp = client.stream(request, retry=...)` which matches current SDK, but want to avoid a breaking example.

sam (SDK): On it — will review by EOD.

jon (Go eng): LGTM for the Go snippet, left a couple tiny nits in the branch (naming + comment).

linda (TS SDK): TS edits pushed and linted. Updated docs link in examples/README.

maria (Docs): Thanks all. Goal: merge before Thursday release window. If you hit blockers ping me directly. :pray:
